rules.statement: A session has no capacity (zero tickets) when a club booking covering the whole rink overlaps it in time.
rules.subject: session effective capacity

rules.statement: A session has no capacity when overlapping club bookings take two or more halves of the rink.
rules.subject: rink halves taken by club bookings

rules.statement: When one half of the rink is taken by an overlapping club booking, the session's capacity is halved, rounded down.
rules.subject: session effective capacity

evidence.quote: if (input.end <= input.start) throw new DomainError(400, "end must be after start");

rules.statement: A session's end time must be after its start time.
rules.subject: session end time

rules.statement: A session's capacity must be a whole number of at least 1.
rules.subject: session capacity

rules.statement: A session's price must be a whole number of cents and cannot be negative.
rules.subject: session price

rules.statement: Only sessions with status open sell tickets; held or cancelled sessions have zero capacity.
rules.subject: session status

rules.statement: Only pending or paid bookings count against a session's tickets and hire stock.
rules.subject: booking status

evidence.quote: return { ticketsLeft: Math.max(0, capacity - ticketsUsed), hireLeft };

rules.statement: Tickets left for a session never go below zero.
rules.subject: tickets left
